summary: Dark theme + Appearance picker + OptiIQ sanity guard tested. Backend 4/4 pass (BRK.B optiiq unavailable with the exact reason; AAPL/MSFT available; valuation board has no BRK.B/SKYD in stocks). Frontend: Profile > Appearance (theme-picker System/Light/Dark) switches the whole app straight away with no reload. The choice is saved in localStorage 'theme_preference' and survives a reload (dark->dark, light->light, system->system). System follows prefers-color-scheme, including live OS changes (emulate_media). Tabs that were already open (Discover/Analyze/Chain/Portfolio/Alerts/Learn) and the tab bar re-render in the new theme. I ran an automated contrast/leftover-light-background scan (/app/tests/contrast_scan.js) in dark mode on: Login, Profile, Discover (Best opportunities + scan results, Find stocks), Analyze (Options Lab AAPL, Swing AAPL, Long-term MSFT incl. DCF inputs, valuation-board, buy-levels after vb-stock-CNC), Chain, Portfolio, Alerts + add-alert modal, Learn + lesson/1 quiz, /track-record (live + backtest), /upgrade, /assistant, /ticker/AAPL, /admin, admin user detail, /admin-broadcast. No leftover light backgrounds and no page errors. Only 1 real unreadable-text bug: the Options Lab POP hero value was black on #1C1C1E (heroVal style had no color). I fixed it. Light mode regression looks unchanged.

ui_bugs.component: Analyze Options Lab hero POP value
ui_bugs.issue: Dark mode: '72.6%' POP value text was default black on dark card (styles.heroVal had no color; only Max profit/loss overrode it). FIXED by adding color: colors.onSurface to heroVal in app/(tabs)/analyze.tsx. Verified it is now white.
Pre-existing, both themes: the /ticker/AAPL chart y-axis runs from $0 to $352, so all candles are squashed into a thin line at the top. The min bound probably includes 0 or an empty/zero data point.

issues: Unselected radio circles on profile-low_high / profile-high_high use borderStrong #545456 on #000 (contrast 2.78:1, below the 3:1 non-text guideline). Consider muted #8E8E93.
Bottom sheet background is #000, the same as the screen. Under the scrim only the rounded corners separate it from the page. iOS dark convention for elevated sheets is surfaceSecondary (#1C1C1E).
Segment items are 40px tall (<44pt touch target).
Items use accessibilityRole='radio' with accessibilityState={{selected}}, so aria-checked is never set. Use accessibilityState={{ checked: on }}.
muted #9CA3AF text on white/#F9FAFB is ~2.5:1 (section labels, 'Hi, Jane', hints). Not a regression.

action_items: Fix /ticker/[symbol] price chart y-axis lower bound ($0), which squashes the candles (pre-existing).
Dark mode polish: use surfaceSecondary for bottom-sheet modals (add-alert) and give the unselected radio rings more contrast.
Theme picker: accessibilityState={{ checked: on }} and minHeight 44.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts design is sound: useSyncExternalStore store + per-scheme cached StyleSheet proxies. No React.memo components were found that could miss re-renders. No hard-coded hex/white/black colors remain in app/ or src/ .tsx files.
Any Text style without an explicit color falls back to black on web, which caused the heroVal bug. Worth a grep for other text styles that lack 'color' (my DOM scan only covers rendered states).
SVG chart texts (buy-levels-chart, track-calibration-chart, track-equity) use fill, so they look fine in screenshots. The scan's 1.23 ratios for these are false positives.

success_rate.frontend: 97% (1 dark-mode text bug found and fixed; 1 pre-existing chart bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme pref is in localStorage 'theme_preference'. It is only applied at app launch, so set it then reload/goto. Reuse /app/tests/contrast_scan.js via page.evaluate(open(path).read()); ignore empty-text icon hits and 1.23 hits from SVG text. Day lab is locked for the advance user (redirects to /upgrade). Set EXPO_BACKEND_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before running pytest.
